reviewer: comparison_design agent; independent review of parent report/supporting calculations

test_verdict.coverage_limit: Fixtures validate mathematics and boundary behavior; they are not an out-of-sample economic forecasting validation.

independent_recomputation.method: Read canonical CSV directly; compute with Python standard library without calling parent research_math/event_window or price helper functions.

same_drawdown_diagnostic.threshold_overshoot_note: First observed crossing is below, rather than exactly equal to, the Korean threshold. Report correctly says similar drawdown.

policy_windows.definition: Pre: close at event_idx-21 to close at event_idx-1 =20 returns. Post: close at event_idx-1 to event_idx+19 =20 returns, including event session.

independent_recomputation.loss_vs_drawdown: path_risks includes origin in running peak and correctly distinguishes worst return from origin from subsequent peak-to-trough drawdown.
independent_recomputation.valuation_arithmetic: Multiplicative EPS/P-E identity and inverse20%-loss threshold are correct for positive same-definition EPS/P-E endpoints; hypothetical inputs explicitly labelled.

predictive_weighting_audit.selection: Retrospective Shanghai crossing conditioned on currently observed KOSPI drawdown; historical peak itself known retrospectively.
report_guards_verified: Explicitly calls a single case and an ex-post conditional comparison
Explicitly denies a Korean6-month return/probability interpretation
252-session right censoring is preserved as null
Scenario table has observations and falsification conditions, without numerical weights
Hypothetical EPS/P-E grid is not labelled a forecast, probability, confidence interval or frequency
predictive_weighting_audit.remaining_limit: The single negative outcome cannot establish how likely another decline is. Near-zero fixed-window return correlation does not test every possible lead/lag or disprove all structural mechanisms.

primary_strong: Official SSE yearbook closing prices and index/valuation definitions
Official Chinese policy/economic releases and Korean policy/BOK/company releases where cited
qualified_secondary: Current Korean daily history largely Yahoo; last close crosschecked to dated Investing history/Yonhap and KOFIA
Korean concentration estimate includes secondary aggregate totals; report marks it conditional
Yahoo daily FX time-of-day is unspecified; report now states that limitation
not_used_for_unsupported_claims: Unverified MSCI WORLD benchmark-relative returns remain null
No independently reproduced global earnings-growth number-one ranking
No measured policy-induced individual flow effect or constituent return contribution
source_grade_verdict.vintage_limit: Retrospectively retrieved histories and later annual reports are used to describe historical outcomes, not represented as contemporaneously available forecasting inputs.

resolved_findings.issue: Original USD paragraph referred to New York fixing time despite actual Yahoo daily FX source lacking a time-of-day definition.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent changed build_report.py, report.md and report.html to state FX close time is unavailable and synchrony with Asian equity closes is unverified.

nonblocking_limits: Only two selected cycles; no population base rate or causal identification
Partial final weekly period is disclosed, complete-month robustness excludesOctober2026
Policy-window announcements lack verified intraday timing and events overlap market/global shocks
Future126/252 Korean outcomes do not yet exist and no speculative line is drawn
write_scope: This review wrote only prices/independent_review_parent.json; tests may write ordinary Python cache files.
